notes.title: More Community Levels!
notes.notes:
The JellyCar Worlds community continues to create amazing levels.  This update adds a new pack of levels to the community showcase, this time focusing on levels that make interesting use of the JellyCar's abilities.

It also adds a new "curve editor" to the level maker, making it easier to make smooth shapes.

notes.title: The Community Showcase begins!
notes.notes: It's time to celebrate the amazing JellyCar Worlds community!  This update introduces the Community Showcase, an area for new packs of levels all created by JellyCar Worlds players, and selected by Walaber!  Try out the first community level pack entitled "Theme Park", and look for more packs to be added in the future!

notes.title: We squeezed in some 2-player modes!
notes.notes: 2-player modes have arrived!  Tether 2 JellyCars together and cooperate through the new co-op world, or split the screen and race to the stop sign in race rush!

notes.title: The final classic level update is here!
notes.notes:
This update concludes adding classic JellyCar levels into JellyCar Worlds.
Over 60 levels from JellyCar 3 have been added in this update, complete with secret exits and challenges.
This update also adds options to customize car abilities in custom levels.

notes.title: Nostalgic JellyCar 2 Levels Arrive
notes.notes:
This update continues the project of adding in levels from the older "classic" versions of the game into JellyCar Worlds.
We have squished in every single level from JellyCar 2 in this update!
Not only are the levels added, but challenges have been added as well.
This update also adds a powerful new "Movement Sequencer" tool to the level editor, allowing even more complex levels to be created.

notes.title: "Break The Record" LIVE Speedrun Tournament
notes.notes:
The top 4 runners will be competing live to set a new record on the "World 7 Rush" category.  Tune in for live commentary from Walaber and other community members!

tune in at [url=https://twitch.tv/walaber]https://twitch.tv/walaber[/url]

notes.title: Players asked for it!
notes.notes:
This update has many player-requested features added:
"Screen Effects" can be added to adjust the visual look of areas in custom levels.
Challenges have been added to the Classic JellyCar 1 levels.
Multiple replays / custom levels can be deleted at once now.
"Out of Bounds" objects can be created in the level editor.
"Pins" can connect objects in the level editor.
Custom objects can now be made into "Cheese" blocks in the editor.
Many other fixes and improvements.

notes.title: W2 Rush Live Speedrun Tournament
notes.notes:
This is our first official community speedrun tournament!

4 talented players will have 2 hours to try and break the record for Level Rush "W2" (play through all 8 World 2 levels back-to-back).

Winner gets a brand new OLED Nintendo Switch!
All competitors will get exclusive JellyCar Worlds physical flipbooks signed by Walaber.

Come tune in and see some high-level JellyCar Worlds play!

live on Walaber's Twitch channel ([url=https://twitch.tv/walaber]https://twitch.tv/walaber[/url])

notes.title: Time travel to Classic Levels & Editor Improvements
notes.notes:
New in this version:

Classic levels (restored level from JellyCar 1) added.

Level Editor improvements:
[list]
[*] Falling custom objects are now possible.
[*] Conveyor belts added.
[*] Laser detectors added.
[*] Checkpoints added.
[/list]

notes.title: Custom Levels have arrived!
notes.notes:
New in this version:
- Level Editor! You can now create and play your own custom levels with a powerful custom level editor.
- Many bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Racing to finish the Worlds Adventure!
notes.notes:
New in this version:
- Added World 8 (the final adventure world) featuring the "turbo" ability
- Added a custom music playlist feature
- Added "Level Rush" for creating custom multi-level race challenges
- Added "Skull Rush" for the ultimate challenge
- Many bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Swinging into World 7!
notes.notes:
[h2]New in this version[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added World 7 featuring the grapple ability
[*] Can now access challenges from Level Complete and other menus
[*] Added On-screen Button control option for iOS
[*] Improved UI for sound recorder
[*] More options when resetting progress such as keeping your car design and best time ghosts
[*] Many bug fixes and optimizations
[/list]
